id: \bThe food is great! Sometimes we get to watch a gym battle too.
en: \bThe food is great! Sometimes we get to watch a gym battle too.
it: \bIl cibo è ottimo! E a volte riusciamo anche a guardare una lotta in Palestra.

id: \bCress: Try Chili first. His passion will burn right through you.
en: \bCress: Try Chili first. His passion will burn right through you.
it: \bChicco: Prima affronta Chicco. La sua passione ti brucerà da parte a parte.

id: \bCress: My turn now. Don't be sorry that you jumped into the deep end.
en: \bCress: My turn now. Don't be sorry that you jumped into the deep end.
it: \bChicco: Ora tocca a me. Non pentirti di esserti tuffato dove non si tocca.

id: \bCress: The final challenge is Cilan. He may snare you in his tactics.
en: \bCress: The final challenge is Cilan. He may snare you in his tactics.
it: \bChicco: L'ultima sfida è Spighetto. Potrebbe intrappolarti con le sue tattiche.

id: \bCress: You are a ripple in the pond. May you continue to touch those around you.
en: \bCress: You are a ripple in the pond. May you continue to touch those around you.
it: \bChicco: Sei come un'onda nello stagno. Possa tu continuare a toccare chi ti sta intorno.

id: \rWelcome to the Striaton Restaurant!
en: \rWelcome to the Striaton Restaurant!
it: \rBenvenuto al Ristorante di Levantopoli!

id: \bCilan uses Grass type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Bug, Fire, Poison, Flying, and Ice types.
en: \bCilan uses Grass type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Bug, Fire, Poison, Flying, and Ice types.
it: \bSpighetto usa Pokémon di tipo Erba. Sono deboli contro i tipi Coleottero, Fuoco, Veleno, Volante e Ghiaccio.

id: \bThey are strong against Water, Ground, and Rock. Electirc, Grass, Ground, and Water moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Water, Ground, and Rock.  Electirc, Grass, Ground, and Water moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Acqua, Terra e Roccia. Anche le mosse di tipo Elettro, Erba, Terra e Acqua non fanno loro molti danni.

id: \bCilan: Welcome to the Striaton Gym. Your aroma is marvelous.
en: \bCilan: Welcome to the Striaton Gym. Your aroma is marvelous.
it: \bSpighetto: Benvenuto alla Palestra di Levantopoli. Il tuo aroma è meraviglioso.

id: \bCilan: It seems my turn has finally come. It's time for the battle to be served.
en: \bCilan: It seems my turn has finally come. It's time for the battle to be served.
it: \bSpighetto: Sembra che finalmente sia arrivato il mio turno. È ora di servire la lotta.

id: \bCilan: Well brothers, it seems \PN has beaten us all.
en: \bCilan: Well brothers, it seems \PN has beaten us all.
it: \bSpighetto: Ebbene, fratelli, sembra che \PN ci abbia battuti tutti.

id: \bYou've earned the Trio Badge.
en: \bYou've earned the Trio Badge.
it: \bHai ottenuto la Medaglia Trio.

id: \bCress: Here, have this TM too.
en: \bCress: Here, have this TM too.
it: \bChicco: Ecco, prendi anche questa MT.

id: \bTM109 contains Dive. A two-turn water type attack.
en: \bTM109 contains Dive. A two-turn water type attack.
it: \bLa MT109 contiene Sub. Un attacco di tipo Acqua in due turni.

id: \bChili: Here's one from me too!
en: \bChili: Here's one from me too!
it: \bMaisello: Eccone una anche da parte mia!

id: \bTM38 contains Fire Blast. A powerful force of fire that may burn your opponent.
en: \bTM38 contains Fire Blast. A powerful force of fire that may burn your opponent.
it: \bLa MT38 contiene Fuocobomba. Una potente vampata di fuoco che può scottare l'avversario.

id: \bCilan: Last but not least, here's one from me.
en: \bCilan: Last but not least, here's one from me.
it: \bSpighetto: Ultima, ma non per importanza, eccone una da parte mia.

id: \bTM108 contains Solar Blade. A two-turn grass type attack.
en: \bTM108 contains Solar Blade. A two-turn grass type attack.
it: \bLa MT108 contiene Lama Solare. Un attacco di tipo Erba in due turni.

id: \bCilan: Your way of battle has inspired me. I'm going to travel the land and savor as many of the savory delights as I can.
en: \bCilan: Your way of battle has inspired me. I'm going to travel the land and savor as many of the savory delights as I can.
it: \bSpighetto: Il tuo modo di lottare mi ha ispirato. Viaggerò per il mondo e assaporerò quante più prelibatezze possibile.

id: \bChili: You seem like a strong challenger.
en: \bChili: You seem like a strong challenger.
it: \bMaisello: Sembri uno sfidante forte.

id: \bCress: Why not battle us all? I'm sure you'll enjoy it.
en: \bCress: Why not battle us all? I'm sure you'll enjoy it.
it: \bChicco: Perché non ci sfidi tutti? Sono sicuro che ti divertirai.

id: \bCilan: An excellent idea! How about you start with Chili for the appetizer, Cress for the main course, and me for desert.
en: \bCilan: An excellent idea! How about you start with Chili for the appetizer, Cress for the main course, and me for desert.
it: \bSpighetto: Idea eccellente! Che ne dici di iniziare con Maisello come antipasto, Maisello come portata principale e me come dessert?

id: \bCress uses Water type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Grass and Electric types.
en: \bCress uses Water type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Grass and Electric types.
it: \bChicco usa Pokémon di tipo Acqua. Sono deboli contro i tipi Erba ed Elettro.

id: \bThey are strong against Fire, Ground, and Rock. Fire, Ice, Steel, and Water moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Fire, Ground, and Rock.  Fire, Ice, Steel, and Water moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Fuoco, Terra e Roccia.  Anche le mosse di tipo Fuoco, Ghiaccio, Acciaio e Acqua non fanno molti danni.

id: \bCilan uses Fire type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Water, Ground, and Rock types.
en: \bCilan uses Fire type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Water, Ground, and Rock types.
it: \bMaisello usa Pokémon di tipo Fuoco. Sono deboli contro i tipi Acqua, Terra e Roccia.

id: \bThey are strong against Bug, Grass, Ice, and Steel. Bug, Grass, Fire, Ice, Steel, and Fairy moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Bug, Grass, Ice, and Steel.  Bug, Grass, Fire, Ice, Steel, and Fairy moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Coleottero, Erba, Ghiaccio e Acciaio.  Anche le mosse di tipo Coleottero, Erba, Fuoco, Ghiaccio, Acciaio e Folletto non fanno molti danni.

id: \bOh, you're here for the gym. It's at the back.
en: \bOh, you're here for the gym. It's at the back.
it: \bOh, sei qui per la Palestra. È in fondo.

id: \bDon't tell me to slow down.
en: \bDon't tell me to slow down.
it: \bNon dirmi di rallentare.

id: \bChili: I'm your first opponent. Let's get this heated up.
en: \bChili: I'm your first opponent. Let's get this heated up.
it: \bMaisello: Sono il tuo primo avversario. Facciamo salire la temperatura.

id: \bChili: Next up is Cress. You'll drown in his skill.
en: \bChili: Next up is Cress. You'll drown in his skill.
it: \bMaisello: Il prossimo è Maisello. Affogherai nella sua abilità.

id: \bChili: Your final challenge is Cilan. It will be a bittersweet battle.
en: \bChili: Your final challenge is Cilan. It will be a bittersweet battle.
it: \bMaisello: La tua ultima sfida è Spighetto. Sarà una lotta agrodolce.

id: \bChili: I can't believe you beat us all. It really burns me up.
en: \bChili: I can't believe you beat us all. It really burns me up.
it: \bMaisello: Non ci credo che ci hai battuti tutti. Mi fa proprio ribollire.
